title: Some probabilistic properties and time-changed versions of a renewal process based on Mittag-Leffler waiting times
summary: In this paper, we obtain some additional probabilistic properties of the renewal process $\{\hat{N}_α(t)\}_{t\ge0}$, $0 0}$ whose distribution is related to a fractional diffusion equation is established. We compute its various distributional properties such as the variance, factorial moments, moment generating function, moments, covariance in the Laplace domain, etc. We show that the ratios given by $\{\hat{N}_α(t)\}_{ t \ge 0}$ and its power over their means tend to $1$ in probability.
